#   python3 -m pip install --require-hashes -r scripts/independent-suite3-requirements.txt
# Each pin lists the SHA-256 of every file PyPI publishes for that version, so pip accepts
# exactly these bytes on any system. cryptography gives OpenSSL's Argon2id; unicodedata2 gives
# the Unicode 18.0.0 character database that Python's own unicodedata does not have yet.
# cffi and pycparser are what cryptography needs.
